summary: Use a rechecked server currency hint to join post-lock Finance Book metadata in one Prisma read; retain canonical fallback and locking.
noAssistantImpact: Finance Book read scheduling only. The void finance.book procedure supplies a server-derived currency hint; current active Owner/Admin/Tenant facts are still read after the unchanged Membership SHARE lock. A bounded joined Book/accounts relation is projected only for matching current Tenant currency. Mismatched hints fall back to the original current-currency lookup; no hint and all native command/assistant callers retain the original guard/reader. Same transaction options, full Book/account DTO, dates/enums, exact sequence strings, finance role/plan gates and error mapping. No public input, new procedure/capability, grant, schema, provider, financial command or deployment.

docs.note: Read/query-only change; no schema, migration, index or persistence change.

evidence.result: Actual API Book caller reproduces three body reads before correction and two after: Membership SHARE lock first, joined fresh permission/Book read second. Server context supplies currency and actor/Tenant; exact large sequence string preserved. Existing current-Book schemas and plan/role error cases remain covered.

Executed opt-in socket-only disposable PostgreSQL fixture. Actual generated Prisma full DTO/Date/enum/account ordering parity, business SELECT count3 to2, 56 role/status/business combinations, arbitrary/mismatched hints, missing Book, real two-reader currency/revocation lock waits and lock retention through commit/rollback. Fixture DBs removed count0 and owned cluster stopped. Existing nine snapshot/ReadCommitted control cases reused from same isolated run. No application DB write.
